propositions: At search exhaustion, BOUNDED_FALLBACK_EVIDENCE incorrectly banks met=false (absence-of-evidence) as evidence-of-absence, causing false FAIL verdicts on tickets whose evidence exists but was not reached within the budget window.
The system must distinguish three evidence outcomes (met, refuted, insufficient) via an optional evidence_sufficient:false marker alongside met:false to signal exhaustion vs genuine refutation.

The fallback_record contract and CriterionBank.upsert must persist the evidence_sufficient marker; record_criterion_verdict remains bool-only and the marker flows exclusively through the framework's banking write path.

Unbanked or exhausted criterion placeholders and fallback-banked entries must emit met=false + evidence_sufficient:false with insufficient-evidence findings; bare met=false indicates genuine refutation only.

The marker must survive schema validation and be preserved on re-harvest (overwrite retains prior marker) and re-stamped from the bank in merge_finalizer_with_bank; close gate and renderers report insufficient evidence + remediation instead of unmet-criteria messages.

All consumer paths (completion_recovery.py, completion.py reconcile_verdict, close_precheck.py, _render_verdict_text, completion_sidecar FAIL payload) must be updated together to handle the tri-state verdict without changing gate logic or exit codes.
